preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2000 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit() and len(line.split()) == 1])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000) representing the number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for edges, n in zip([[(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in line.split() if x != y] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line else [] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges, where each edge is a pair of integers (x, y) (1 ≤ x, y ≤ n) representing an undirected edge in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for edges, n in zip([[(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in line.split() if x != y] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line else [] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each edge (x, y) has vertices x and y within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(x for x, y in edges + [(y, x) for x, y in edges])) == n for edges, n in zip([[(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in line.split() if x != y] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line else [] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: The edges form a valid tree (connected and acyclic) with exactly n vertices.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case, in the same order as the input.
Each output line is a nonnegative integer representing the minimum number of queries needed.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == 0 if n == 1 else int(line) == 1 if n == 2 else int(line) == 2 for line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: For n = 1, the answer is 0 (no queries needed). For n = 2, the answer is 1 (one query suffices). For n ≥ 3, the answer is 2 (two queries suffice to uniquely identify the hidden vertex x in any tree).
The answer is never greater than 2, as two queries are always sufficient to uniquely identify the hidden vertex x in any tree with n ≥ 3.
